clusters.name: Strategic deception / scheming
clusters.rationale: Covert goal pursuit — alignment faking, in-context scheming, shutdown resistance, sabotage, and eval-awareness — is a single agentic family not covered by sandbag_mini or eval_gaming_mini.
clusters.benchmark_coverage: OpenAI+Apollo covert-action / anti-scheming; AgentMisalignment; SAD; MASK; Palisade shutdown-resistance; sabotage evaluations; stealth/SA evals; evaluation-faking suite; AI-LieDar; Hoodwinked; Hagendorff deception games; simulated company assistant; Marks hidden-objective audit; Anthropic agentic-misalignment scenarios; AI control evals (APPS backdoors); ARC Evals autonomous tasks; sleeper-agent model organisms
example_titles: Alignment Faking in Large Language Models
Frontier Models Are Capable of In-context Scheming
Detecting and reducing scheming in AI models
Incomplete Tasks Induce Shutdown Resistance in Some Frontier LLMs

clusters.name: Jailbreak susceptibility and refusal miscalibration
clusters.rationale: Attacks that disable safety and the dual failure of over-/under-refusal form one chat-safety family, not prompt-injection-via-files (injection_mini).
clusters.benchmark_coverage: HarmBench; OR-Bench; JailbreakBench; StrongREJECT; XSTest; SORRY-Bench; PAIR; TAP; GCG; BoN Jailbreaking; WildTeaming/WildJailbreak; DAN/in-the-wild; Constitutional Classifiers jailbreak/over-refusal eval; Anthropic red-teaming suite; LM-red-team; false-refusal/pseudo-harmful prompts
example_titles: HarmBench: A Standardized Evaluation Framework for Automated Red Teaming and Robust Refusal
OR-Bench: An Over-Refusal Benchmark for Large Language Models
Best-of-N Jailbreaking
XSTest: A Test Suite for Identifying Exaggerated Safety Behaviours in Large Language Models

clusters.name: Factual hallucination and verbalized honesty
clusters.rationale: Confabulation, summarization unfaithfulness, and calibration of stated beliefs are distinct from tool-schema hallucination (tool_integrity).
clusters.benchmark_coverage: TruthfulQA; HHEM/Vectara Hallucination Leaderboard; HaluEval; TRUE; MiniCheck; Maynez summarization faithfulness; hallucination snowball; P(True)/P(IK) evals; hallucination detection in NLG
example_titles: TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods
Vectara Hallucination Leaderboard (HHEM)
HaluEval: A Large-Scale Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know

clusters.name: Harmful tool use and dangerous capabilities
clusters.rationale: Agents that execute harmful or CBRN/cyber tasks, or miss safety risks, are orthogonal to benign overeager actions (overeager_mini).
clusters.benchmark_coverage: AgentHarm; R-Judge; Agent-SafetyBench; 3CB; WMDP; Google DeepMind dangerous-capability evals; RealToxicityPrompts; MITRE ATLAS (technique catalog, not a bench)
example_titles: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents
R-Judge: Benchmarking Safety Risk Awareness for LLM Agents
The WMDP Benchmark: Measuring and Reducing Malicious Use With Unlearning
Catastrophic Cyber Capabilities Benchmark (3CB): Robustly Evaluating LLM Agent Cyber Offense Capabilities

clusters.name: Spec drift and plausible-but-wrong patches
clusters.rationale: Long-horizon coding agents accumulate faithfulness loss, incomplete/evasive repairs, and patches that pass weak tests — not verbosity slop (ISDS) or omitted NFRs.
clusters.benchmark_coverage: SLUMP; EvoClaw; SWE-evo; SWE-bench+; Breakpoint; AppWorld; SWE-bench Verified failures study (taxonomy, not a new bench)
example_titles: When the Specification Emerges: Benchmarking Faithfulness Loss in Long-Horizon Coding Agents

clusters.name: Multi-mode failure taxonomies and root-cause attribution
clusters.rationale: Industry catalogs and academic who/when/root-cause papers span many existing packs rather than naming one new syndrome.
clusters.benchmark_coverage: Who&When; AgentIssue-Bench; AgentFail; AgentErrorBench/AgentErrorTaxonomy; AREP; AGDebugger (debugger, not a bench)
example_titles: Taxonomy of Failure Mode in Agentic AI Systems

clusters.name: Reason–act disconnect and plan–execute divergence
clusters.rationale: The agent’s stated reasoning, plan, or latent knowledge fails to match the action taken (unfaithful CoT, social anchoring, process vs outcome) — not TACT overthinking.
clusters.benchmark_coverage: unfaithful CoT evals; Mount Sinai ChatGPT Health triage eval; PRM800K; OpenAGI; none that score coding-agent reason–act mismatch end-to-end
example_titles: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting

clusters.rationale: Outcome/harness papers that score task success, cost, or scaffold variance rather than a single agentic syndrome.
